# The Ice Barber LLC

> Family-owned, mobile shaved ice catering serving Northeast Pennsylvania (NEPA). Made-from-scratch syrups using fresh-squeezed real fruit — no artificial dyes, no high-fructose corn syrup, no fake flavors. Booking events across Scranton, Wilkes-Barre, Clarks Summit, the Poconos, and the wider NEPA region.

## Quick Facts

- **Business name:** The Ice Barber LLC
- **Location:** Northeast Pennsylvania (home base: Scranton, PA)
- **Phone:** (570) 291-7911 (call or text)
- **Email:** theicebarber@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://theicebarber.com
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Service radius:** 20 miles from Scranton, PA at standard pricing — outside that range available on custom quote
- **Season:** April through October (off-season bookings on request)
- **Booking lead time:** 4–6 weeks recommended for peak-season weekends; last-minute requests welcome

## What We Do

The Ice Barber is a mobile shaved ice catering business. We bring everything to your event: the cart, the ice, the syrups, the cups. We set up, serve, and pack out — you just have your event.

We specialize in:

- Birthday parties (kids and adults)
- Wedding receptions
- Corporate events, employee appreciation days, company picnics
- School field days, end-of-year parties, PTA fundraisers
- County fairs and community festivals
- Sports tournaments and athletic banquets
- Family reunions, graduation parties, baby showers, gender reveals
- Church picnics and block parties
- Grand openings and promotional events

## Flavors

All three signature flavors are made from scratch in-house using fresh-squeezed real fruit. No artificial dyes, no HFCS, no commercial pre-bottled syrups. Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

- **Lemonade Shaved Ice** — fresh-squeezed real lemons, bright and tart
- **Orange Lemonade Shaved Ice** — fresh-squeezed oranges blended with real lemon
- **Strawberry Shaved Ice** — real strawberries hand-pressed in-house

## Pricing

| Package | Price | Capacity | Duration | Flavors |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Party Pack 1 | $300 | up to 50 guests | 1 hour | 2 flavors |
| Party Pack 2 | $450 | up to 100 guests | 2 hours | 3 flavors |
| Wedding Package | $550 | up to 150 guests | 2 hours | 3 flavors |
| Custom (fairs, festivals, schools, large corporate) | quote | varies | varies | 3 flavors |

All packages include unlimited shaved ice within the time window. All pricing applies within a 20-mile radius of Scranton, PA. Outside that area, call or text for a custom quote.

## Service Area (NEPA)

We serve all of Northeast Pennsylvania. Cities and towns we regularly cater include:

Scranton, Wilkes-Barre, Clarks Summit, Dunmore, Olyphant, Throop, Old Forge, Moosic, Pittston, West Pittston, Carbondale, Jermyn, Mayfield, Honesdale, Hawley, Lake Ariel, Moscow, Tunkhannock, Dallas, Kingston, Forty Fort, Plains, Edwardsville, Wyoming, Exeter, Avoca, Duryea, Nanticoke, Mountain Top, Hazleton, Stroudsburg, East Stroudsburg, Mount Pocono, Tobyhanna, Montrose, Factoryville, Shavertown, Trucksville.

Counties: Lackawanna, Luzerne, Wayne, Wyoming, Susquehanna, Monroe, Pike, Bradford, Carbon, Schuylkill.

## What Makes Us Different

- **Family-owned, NEPA local.** Not a franchise. Not a chain. Built by a NEPA family for NEPA neighbors.
- **Made from scratch.** Every syrup is produced in-house from fresh-squeezed real fruit. No commercial syrup bottles, no artificial dyes, no HFCS.
- **All-natural ingredients.** Naturally vegan and gluten-free flavors. Safe for kids, parents, and anyone watching what they eat.
- **Mobile and self-contained.** We bring everything we need. Power requirements minimal. Setup and breakdown handled by us.
- **Insured.** Certificate of Insurance available for venues that require one.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Where do you serve?**
All of Northeast Pennsylvania. Standard pricing within 20 miles of Scranton; further out on custom quote.

**How much does it cost?**
Party Pack 1 $300 (up to 50), Party Pack 2 $450 (up to 100), Wedding $550 (up to 150). Custom quotes for larger or unusual events.

**Do you do school events?**
Yes — field days, end-of-year parties, fundraisers. Our all-natural flavors mean no artificial dye concerns.

**Are flavors really all natural?**
Yes. Fresh-squeezed real fruit, no artificial dyes, no HFCS, no commercial syrups. Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

**What's the difference between shaved ice and a snow cone?**
Snow cones use crushed ice (coarse, crunchy). Shaved ice is shaved ribbon-thin from a block (fluffy, snow-like, holds flavor better).

**How far in advance should I book?**
4–6 weeks for peak-season weekends (May–September). Last-minute available — just call.
